states: Existing webhook section in a source-isolated offline fixture, using the real component, state owners and API adapters
Deferred bulk and individual writes, unchanged rows, 503 partial failure with earlier acknowledged changes retained
Unaccepted deletion, deliberate retry, open masked draft and retired editor
interactions: Bulk Disable with blocked competing Enable, row deletion and new editor entry; one acknowledged write at a time
Explicit retry changes only remaining changed rows; no editor retry or rollback on failure
Single toggle and deletion share pending admission; success:false preserves the row, success:true removes it
Edit/Cancel retain the existing mask and draft fields, while list controls remain disabled
Leave the editor while a batch is pending: no remaining unsent write is issued
scope: Targeted existing section fixture and synthetic local API endpoints, not full authenticated application, provider delivery or installed recovery.
